children.text: Let $$$bit(x)$$$ denote the number of ones in the binary representation of a non-negative integer $$$x$$$.
A subarray of an array is called

if it consists only of numbers with no more than $$$k$$$ ones in their binary representation, i.e., a subarray $$$(l, r)$$$ of array $$$a$$$ is good if for any $$$i$$$ such that $$$l \le i \le r$$$ condition $$$bit(a_{i}) \le k$$$ is satisfied.
